source: APFM_Flow's UpdateContactAttributes block (action eeae1640-8792-4bd2-8afd-d071c3d10aca) writes relation, interest, phone_and_location and city from APFM_Bot's customerintake slots. Those four are the same ones APFM_Intake_Guide renders as $.Attributes.*, so this panel and the agent's step-by-step guide read identical values. customer_id and account_number are demo stand-ins for a CRM lookup — the flow must set them for them to appear.

attributes.label: Relationship
attributes.help: From the RelationType slot — who the caller is to the person they are enquiring for.

attributes.label: Interest
attributes.help: From the InterestType slot — the service the caller asked about.

attributes.label: Account number
attributes.help: Masked on screen. Reveal shows the full value; it is excluded from Copy for notes either way.
